thingdescriptiongroups.description: Thing Description containers. Each Group holds Thing Descriptions that are related in some application-defined way, such as all Things of a tenant, a fleet or a physical site

thingdescriptions.description: A W3C WoT Thing Description, served as a document. Each Version holds one complete WoT-TD 1.1 JSON-LD document; optional resolution-plan profiles do not create a third Resource kind or make an unresolved plan a validated result

format.name: format
format.description: The document format. All Versions of a Thing Description share one format

wotid.name: wotid
wotid.description: The authored WoT identifier of this Thing Description - the value of the document's 'id' member, verbatim. It is the document's identity in the WoT identifier space and is distinct from the thingdescriptionid, which is the Resource id within this registry and is chosen by the client. All Versions of a Thing Description share one wotid; it MUST NOT encode a revision of the document it names

derivedfrom.name: derivedfrom
derivedfrom.description: The authored WoT identifiers of the Thing Models this Thing Description extends or composes - authored identifiers, not xids, so a resolver matches them against the document's own references directly

license.name: license
license.description: The license the document is offered under, as an SPDX license expression or a URL. Advisory provenance metadata

publisher.name: publisher
publisher.description: The organization that published the document. Advisory provenance metadata

standardsbody.name: standardsbody
standardsbody.description: The standards organization that defines or endorses the document, where one does, for example 'W3C' or 'OPC Foundation'. Advisory provenance metadata

canonicalurl.name: canonicalurl
canonicalurl.description: The canonical upstream location of the document, where it is also published outside this registry. Advisory provenance metadata

maturity.name: maturity
maturity.description: How established the document is, letting a Consumer prefer an official definition over an ad hoc one. Advisory provenance metadata that does not affect the semantic identity of the document

documentdigest.name: documentdigest
documentdigest.description: Server-computed digest of the exact stored document file octets. Present only when the registry implements the WoT digest-publication profile; not a Version immutability guarantee

value.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits encoding the full SHA-256 digest

documentbase.name: documentbase
documentbase.description: Optional original absolute document location used as a document-loader starting location only under an authorized resolver profile; it does not override authored TD base or JSON-LD processing

resolutionpolicy.name: resolutionpolicy
resolutionpolicy.description: Optional suggested policy attachment; never an authorization or activation instruction

digest.description: Full SHA-256 digest of the exact policy file octets

resolutionrecords.name: resolutionrecords
resolutionrecords.description: Optional immutable, digest-pinned resolution-record attachments. Multiple records may describe separate approved uses of the same document

digest.description: Full SHA-256 digest of the exact record file octets

rootdigest.description: Full SHA-256 digest of the root document file octets bound by this record

purpose.description: Optional descriptive use label; not an authorization

thingmodelgroups.description: Thing Model containers. Each Group holds Thing Models that are related in some application-defined way, such as all Thing Models published by one vendor or belonging to one product family

thingmodels.description: A W3C WoT Thing Model, served as a document. Each Version holds one complete WoT-TM 1.1 JSON-LD document; optional resolution-plan profiles do not create a third Resource kind or make an unresolved plan a validated result

wotprocessinggroups.description: WoT processing profile descriptors and reusable processing configurations. These documents are discoverable inputs, not executable code, authorization, or deployment instructions

processingprofiles.description: A WoT-domain processing profile descriptor, served as a JSON document. Its stable identity names the descriptor but does not make a mutable Core Version's document bytes immutable

format.name: format
format.description: The document format. All Versions of a processing profile share one format

stableprofileuri.name: stableprofileuri
stableprofileuri.description: The stable logical URI equal to the descriptor document's id. It identifies the profile across document revisions and is not a Core Version ID or byte-integrity guarantee

processingconfigurations.description: A reusable, root-free WoT processing configuration, served as a JSON document. It does not select a root, target, operation, or deployment and must be explicitly selected by a consumer

format.name: format
format.description: The document format. All Versions of a processing configuration share one format

configurationuri.name: configurationuri
configurationuri.description: The stable logical URI equal to the configuration document's id. It identifies the configuration across document revisions and is not a Core Version ID or byte-integrity guarantee
